name: Cicada Killer
desc: Cicada Killer (Sphecius speciosus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Sphecius speciosus, the eastern cicada-killer wasp, is a large, solitary digger wasp species in the family Bembicidae. They are so named because they hunt cicadas and provision their nests with them.
